Why we're building this

If someone sent you this, it's for a reason.

We're letting the people closest to us in first — because we think you'll love what we're building, and because founders shape it with us.

In a city obsessed with wellness, healthy people still have to duct-tape their life together — a gym in one place, a healthy lunch in another, a sauna across town, coworking somewhere else, and events just to meet good people. You pay for all of it, commute between all of it, and still feel like something's missing.

So we're putting it under one roof. Smash Wellness Club is healthy food, a gym, sauna and cold plunge, hot yoga, coworking, Medellín's first non-alcoholic elixir bar, and a real community — all in one place, all day. Built on Smash, the city's #1 healthy restaurant.

Who's building it

Two founders who already do this.

Lorenzo Boscardi
Founder and operator of Smash — Medellín's #1 healthy restaurant. 5 locations, 20,000+ customers a month, 8 years in.
Jordan Carroll
Builds Medellín's biggest wellness communities — Medellín Run Club, Sweat & Chill, and 11am Presents — 30 to 1,000 people together every week.
🗣️ And we're not guessing on what to build. We've interviewed dozens of health-conscious people across Medellín, and we're using their input to build their new home away from home.
What we're building

Everything, under one roof.

Questions?

Good to know.

When does the club open?
We're targeting early-to-mid 2027. The moment you join, your founding rate and perks are locked in.
When do my months start?
The day we open, the clock starts ticking — not before. And if we don't open, you get your money back.
What if I move or change my mind?
It's fully refundable. If we don't open, or you need out before we do, you get every peso back.
Can I upgrade later?
Yes — you can move up from the Month or 6-Month to a 6- or 12-month anytime before we open, at the founding rate.
Can I gift it or buy more than one?
Yes — buy one for you and one for someone else, or several. Just adjust the quantity at checkout.
Does this give me equity in the company?
No — this is purely toward a membership, not equity or ownership. When we open, this same membership sells at retail for more than founding members pay now, and with fewer perks. You're just locking in the best deal, first.
Where does my money go?
Into a dedicated account we won't touch until we've raised the full amount to build the whole project. If we don't open, you get it all back.
The fine print, in plain words

No risk. Your money is safe.

Your fully refundable deposit toward your founding membership goes into a dedicated account that we won't touch until we've raised the full amount needed to build the whole project. If we don't finish it and don't open, you get your money back — every peso. Access begins the day we open (targeted early-to-mid 2027). Gift-card credit works the same way: pre-purchased credit toward Smash Wellness Club, honored when we open, never expires, fully refundable. This is a membership pre-sale and a gift purchase — not an investment or a security. Questions? Just reply to the message that sent you here.
